# hiok_role_assignment (Resource)

Grants a user, group or identity a role on a resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_email` (String) User or identity to grant the role to.
- `resource_id` (String) The resource's id.
- `resource_type` (String) e.g. storageaccount, virtualmachine, keyvault, resourcegroup.
- `role` (String) Role name, e.g. Reader, Contributor, Owner (see data.hiok_roles).

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `principal_name` (String)
- `principal_type` (String) user (default), group or identity.
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
